All descendants of excluded elements are dropped

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".sidebar\"]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<body><aside class=\"sidebar\"><h2>Related</h2><p>Sidebar text</p></aside><main><p>Main text</p></main></body>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
